Son of Odin, you stand before the Well of Urd, and the threads here speak of you. We have watched your valiant stand, felt the tremor of your hammer, but the weave of your fate is... tangled. The serpent’s venom, Jörmungandr’s foul essence, lingers in your veins. Whether it will consume your godly strength or, with time, simply pass like a shadow, even we Norns cannot yet say.

For now, you must withdraw from this battle. A full cycle of the moon, Thor, you must rest and let us read the shifting threads. And I cannot promise you will wield Mjölnir as before. The future is... clouded.
